description: Fetch OHLCV price history for a token from the keyless GeckoTerminal market API (resolves the token's deepest pool, then returns candles). Use for an agent to reason about recent price action before quoting. Prices come from a single pool that may be thin or manipulated, so treat them as advisory, not a sole execution signal. The keyless tier is a shared ~30 req/min quota, so cache and do not poll tightly. Read-only.

aggregate.description: Bucket multiple base units into one candle, e.g. timeframe=hour aggregate=4 = 4h candles (default 1).

name: get_token_chart
